question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dainty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., Crude.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dainty"** means something that is delicately small, pretty, or elegant. (सुरुचिपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **She served the tea in dainty little cups that looked very elegant on the table.
 
 
 
• **"Crude" **refers to something that is raw, unrefined, or lacking in sophistication or elegance. It is the opposite of "dainty." (अपरिष्कृत, असंस्कृत)
 
 
• **Example: **The artist’s early work was crude and lacked the finesse of his later masterpieces.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dainty' **is **'crude'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., Crude.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exquisite **(अति सुंदर, उत्कृष्ट): Something that is extremely beautiful, elegant, or finely detailed.

 
 
• **Example:** The bride wore an exquisite wedding dress adorned with intricate embroidery.
 
 
 
• **Cute **(प्यारा): Attractive in a charming or endearing way.
 
 
• **Example: **The baby’s laugh was so cute that everyone in the room couldn’t stop smiling.
 
 
 
• **Graceful** (सुगठित, सुंदर): Having or showing elegance and beauty in movement or form.
 
 
• **Example:** The dancer moved with such a graceful flow that the audience was mesmerized.
 
 

30:Tc74,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
